notes: Adds normalized-LUT direct XYZ motion and coordinated production XY motion with bounded terminal guarantees.
Adds MCU XY failure context, bounded homing recovery for rejected move starts, and guided operator recovery for failed XY motion.
Hardens firmware watchdog, motion-limit, pressure, gripper, flash, and printing behavior while expanding verification coverage.
Makes canonical calibration recording and history authoritative, with historical conversion, recovery, and refined Droplet and Stream calibration workflows.
Improves durable experiment execution, resume behavior, experiment editing, workflow diagnostics, and hardware-isolated verification.

The application and bundled firmware must be deployed together because command handling and reset-diagnostic extensions evolved in lockstep; the application updater does not flash firmware automatically.

requires_firmware.note: Firmware is updated for this release candidate and must be installed with the v1.3.0-rc.1 application; do not pair this application with v1.2.0 firmware.

summary: Release candidate for coordinated motion, recovery, calibration, and workflow-reliability improvements.
validation: Focused qualification: direct_xyz_lut_v1, normal_xy_route_v1, coordinated_xy_production_mres3_v5, and coordinated_xy_camera_transition_v4 on LC-001
